defmodule CryptoRateLimit do
  @moduledoc """
  Cryptographic signing service with rate limiting and retry logic.
  Uses HMAC-SHA256 for message authentication codes.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @max_requests_per_minute 100
  @retry_delays [100, 500, 2000, 5000]
  @key_rotation_interval_ms 3_600_000

  defstruct [
    :current_key,
    :previous_key,
    :request_count,
    :window_start,
    :audit_log,
    :key_id
  ]

  # --- Public API ---

  def start_link(opts \\ []) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def sign_message(message, metadata \\ %{}) when is_binary(message) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:sign, message, metadata})
  end

  def verify_signature(message, signature) when is_binary(message) and is_binary(signature) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:verify, message, signature})
  end

  def get_audit_log do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :get_audit_log)
  end

  # --- GenServer Callbacks ---

  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    key = generate_key()
    schedule_key_rotation()

    state = %__MODULE__{
      current_key: key,
      previous_key: nil,
      request_count: 0,
      window_start: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond),
      audit_log: [],
      key_id: Keyword.get(opts, :key_id, "primary")
    }

    {:ok, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:sign, message, metadata}, _from, state) do
    case check_rate_limit(state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        result = do_sign_with_retry(message, new_state.current_key, 0)
        log_entry = format_audit_entry(:sign, message, metadata, new_state)
        updated_state = %{new_state | audit_log: [log_entry | new_state.audit_log]}
        {:reply, result, updated_state}

      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        Logger.warning("Rate limit exceeded")
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call({:verify, message, signature}, _from, state) do
    case check_rate_limit(state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        result = do_verify(message, signature, new_state)
        {:reply, result, new_state}

      {:error, :rate_limited} ->
        {:reply, {:error, :rate_limited}, state}
    end
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_audit_log, _from, state) do
    {:reply, {:ok, state.audit_log}, state}
  end

  @impl true
  def handle_info(:rotate_key, state) do
    new_key = generate_key()
    schedule_key_rotation()

    new_state = %{state |
      previous_key: state.current_key,
      current_key: new_key
    }

    Logger.info("Key rotated successfully for key_id=#{state.key_id}")
    {:noreply, new_state}
  end

  # --- Private Functions ---

  defp check_rate_limit(state) do
    now = System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)
    window_elapsed = now - state.window_start

    cond do
      window_elapsed > 60_000 ->
        {:ok, %{state | request_count: 1, window_start: now}}

      state.request_count < @max_requests_per_minute ->
        {:ok, %{state | request_count: state.request_count + 1}}

      true ->
        {:error, :rate_limited}
    end
  end

  defp do_sign_with_retry(message, key, attempt) when attempt < length(@retry_delays) do
    try do
      signature = compute_hmac(message, key)
      {:ok, signature}
    rescue
      e ->
        delay = Enum.at(@retry_delays, attempt)
        Logger.warning("Sign attempt #{attempt + 1} failed, retrying in #{delay}ms")
        Process.sleep(delay)
        do_sign_with_retry(message, key, attempt + 1)
    end
  end

  defp do_sign_with_retry(_message, _key, _attempt) do
    {:error, :max_retries_exceeded}
  end

  defp do_verify(message, signature, state) do
    current_valid = secure_compare(compute_hmac(message, state.current_key), signature)

    previous_valid =
      if state.previous_key do
        secure_compare(compute_hmac(message, state.previous_key), signature)
      else
        false
      end

    if current_valid or previous_valid do
      {:ok, :valid}
    else
      {:error, :invalid_signature}
    end
  end

  defp compute_hmac(message, key) do
    :crypto.mac(:hmac, :sha256, key, message)
    |> Base.encode16(case: :lower)
  end

  defp secure_compare(a, b) when byte_size(a) != byte_size(b), do: false
  defp secure_compare(a, b) do
    a_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(a)
    b_bytes = :binary.bin_to_list(b)

    Enum.zip(a_bytes, b_bytes)
    |> Enum.reduce(0, fn {x, y}, acc -> Bitwise.bor(acc, Bitwise.bxor(x, y)) end)
    |> Kernel.==(0)
  end

  defp format_audit_entry(operation, message, metadata, state) do
    timestamp = DateTime.utc_now() |> DateTime.to_iso8601()
    client_info = Map.get(metadata, :client_id, "unknown")
    request_detail = Map.get(metadata, :request_info, "")

    # Fixed format - no user-controlled template
    log_template = "[~s] op=~s client=~s key_id=~s msg_prefix=~s detail=~s"

    msg_prefix = String.slice(message, 0, 8)

    :io_lib.format(log_template, [
      timestamp,
      Atom.to_string(operation),
      sanitize_log_value(client_info),
      state.key_id,
      msg_prefix,
      sanitize_log_value(request_detail)
    ])
    |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
  end

  defp sanitize_log_value(value) when is_binary(value) do
    value
    |> String.replace("~", "")
    |> String.slice(0, 256)
  end

  defp sanitize_log_value(value), do: inspect(value)

  defp generate_key do
    :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(32)
  end

  defp schedule_key_rotation do
    Process.send_after(self(), :rotate_key, @key_rotation_interval_ms)
  end
end
